2607.23286.title: TopoFE: topology-aware LLM-guided Automated Feature Engineering
2607.23286.paper_summary: Automatic feature engineering (AutoFE) for tabular learning can be naturally formulated as a program synthesis problem, where the objective is to discover predictive feature transformations from an exponentially large search space. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded the expressiveness of AutoFE by enabling feature program generation beyond predefined operator libraries. However, existing LLM-based approaches remain fundamentally limited by stateless generation and homogeneous search: feature proposals are produced from static prompts without accumulating search experience, while single-population exploration quickly converges to dominant transformation patterns and rarely discovers complementary feature compositions across transformation families. We propose TOPOFE, a topology-aware multi-island evolutionary framework for LLM-guided feature engineering. TOPOFE combines family-specialized exploration, adaptive prompt memory, and topology-guided knowledge transfer to efficiently discover diverse and compositional feature programs. Experiments on 29 public tabular datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art AutoFE methods across classification and regression tasks. Beyond predictive performance, TOPOFE discovers more diverse and transferable feature programs that generalize across multiple downstream predictors and LLM backbones.
2607.23286.paper_summary_zh: 自動特徵工程（AutoFE）對於表格學習可以自然地被表述為一個程序合成問題，其目標是從一個指數級大的搜索空間中發現預測特徵轉換。最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展擴展了AutoFE的表達能力，使得特徵程序生成超越了預定義的運算符庫。然而，現有的基於LLM的方法在根本上仍然受到無狀態生成和同質搜索的限制：特徵提案是從靜態提示中產生的，沒有累積搜索經驗，而單一族群的探索很快會收斂到主導的轉換模式，並且很少能發現跨轉換族的互補特徵組合。我們提出了TOPOFE，一種拓撲感知的多島嶼進化框架，用於LLM引導的特徵工程。TOPOFE結合了家族專門的探索、自適應提示記憶和拓撲引導的知識轉移，以高效地發現多樣化和組合性的特徵程序。在29個公共表格數據集上的實驗顯示，TOPOFE在分類和回歸任務上相較於最先進的AutoFE方法有著持續的改進。除了預測性能外，TOPOFE還發現了更多多樣且可轉移的特徵程序，這些程序能夠在多個下游預測器和LLM骨幹之間進行泛化。
2607.23286.author: Sha Li et.al.
